standing: curated: a received map of what can be looked at, not a measurement. Competency per family is MEASURED by the bench (organs/tschichold.js competency()).
principle: Carriers partitioned by the signal's own dimensions (symbols, plane, sound, plane-in-time, timed symbols, space, container); in every carrier the same three questions — ground (the medium and what of it is not content), figure (units and their roles), pattern (their arrangement). The CV parent LOOKS once; what it saw becomes a byte rule; the rule is falsified on similar-but-not-identical material; then the bytes are read without looking.

carriers.C1: a discrete stream of symbols — text, notation, code, records
carriers.C2: a plane — a page image, a graphic
carriers.C3: a continuous signal in time — sound
carriers.C4: a plane in time — video, animation
carriers.C5: discrete symbols in time — MIDI, captions, logs, motion
carriers.C6: coordinates in space — geodata, models, drawings
carriers.C7: a container of the above — PDF, web page, e-book, mail, package

looks.renderText: render the bytes as a reader sees them (organs/look.js renderTextToImage, or the source's own HTML in a browser) → tesseract TSV layout (block/line/word boxes) → layout facts; compare with the byte reading
looks.page: the page image itself (the-fold/pdf-read.js renderPdfPage; a scan) → tesseract TSV layout + OpenCV boxes/connectors (visual-rec.mjs detectVisualStructure) → layout facts; compare with pdftotext -layout / OCR bytes
looks.graphic: the image → OpenCV regions, connectors, text boxes (detectVisualStructure) + per-region OCR → labelled regions; compare with any caption/alt/metadata bytes
looks.sound: render a spectrogram / waveform image (adapters/audio: frames, chroma, moments) → bands, onsets, silences seen as regions; compare with the sample stream's own measures
looks.video: sample frames at shot boundaries (adapters/video frame differences) → look at keyframes as pages/graphics; compare with caption/subtitle bytes
looks.timed: render a timeline / piano roll of the events → look at the image; compare with the event bytes
looks.space: project to an image (map render / orthographic views) → look; compare with the coordinate bytes
looks.container: unpack; render the package the way its reader would (browser, PDF viewer, e-reader) → look at pages; compare with each member's bytes
